name: @guardbee/mcp-secret-scanner
description: MCP server that scans files and directories for exposed secrets, API keys, and credentials
long_description: Scans text, single files, or entire directories for exposed secrets and API keys using a built-in pattern library (AWS, Stripe, Twilio, SendGrid, private keys, and more). Automatically skips node_modules, .git, dist, and binary files. No API key required — runs entirely locally.
